requires_implementation_before_launch: Stable dataset content identity excluding wall_seconds and strict per-file verification
Explicit legacy manifest compatibility without editing old checkpoints
goal_frame support in all physical, imagined, critic, evaluation and diagnostic paths
Campaign-specific verified publication and deletion allowlist

evidence.beyondmimic_scope: Relative anchor orientation remains in G1FlatWoStateEstimationEnvCfg; not proof of SuperMimic's unpublished exact goal encoding

include_content_definition: actual source and processed file hashes
data_identity.legacy_compatibility: Known original manifest plus verified actual file contents; no hash rewriting or bypass

phase_a.probe_interpretation: Semantic probes on recorded real trajectories, not physical task success

paired_training.goal_definition: Future orientation and root velocities expressed in Q; Q is reference heading for A and current robot root quaternion for B
paired_training.orientation_assumption: Current simulated root orientation, predicted root orientation in imagination; hardware estimator not validated
paired_training.initialization: Fresh identical network and RNG initialization, not a trained checkpoint warm start
paired_training.execution: sequential in dedicated tmux; other projects may continue
paired_training.unchanged_from: configs/lafan40_termination_analytic_smooth.json except the common budget and implemented goal_frame field
paired_training.wall_cap_behavior: Do not extend; report actual finals and largest shared published 1000-iteration milestone

evaluation.primary_score: Original full-motion success and full-duration normalized return
evaluation.additional_tracking_coverage: alive AND root position error <=0.3m AND root SO3 error <=0.4rad, divided by full reference steps; failed tail zero
evaluation.prediction_counts: All 120 plus pre-failure subset; report first-failure counts

continuation_criterion.scope: Predeclared engineering criterion, not paper success or statistical significance
continuation_criterion.negative_result_action: Publish all results and stop; retain confirmed correctness fixes

stop: After two bounded runs, complete evaluation, publication, verified artifact cleanup and explanation; no automatic expansion
